description.en: The ID of the migration task.

description.zh:
迁移源名称。长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以http:\//和https:\//开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者连字符（-）。

默认值：空
description.en:
The name of the source server. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter and cannot start with \`http\://\` or \`https\://\`. The name can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

Default value: empty.

description.zh:
返回的迁移源列表的页码。起始值：1。

默认值：1。
description.en:
The page number. Pages start from page 1.

Default value: 1.

description.zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。最大值：50。

默认值：10。
description.en:
The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 50.

Default value: 10.
The type of the associated task.
The ID of the resource group.
The ID of the source server. You can specify multiple IDs.

description.zh:
迁移源状态。取值范围：

- Unavailable：不可用，包括离线和出错。
- Available：在线。
- InUse：迁移中。
- Deleting：删除中。
description.en:
The state of the source server. Valid values:

- Unavailable: The source server is unavailable. This includes offline and error states.

- Available: The source server is online.

- InUse: The source server is being migrated.

- Deleting: The source server is being deleted.

description.zh:
为SMC资源指定的标签键。N的取值范围：1~20

一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持64个字符，不能以aliyun和acs:开头，不能包含http:\//或者https:\//。
description.en:
The key of tag N. N can be an integer from 1 to 20.

The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length. It cannot start with \`aliyun\` or \`acs:\` and cannot contain \`http\://\` or \`https\://\`.

description.zh:
为SMC资源指定的标签值。N的取值范围：1~20。

一旦传入该值，可以为空字符串。最多支持64个字符，不能包含http:\//或者https:\//。
description.en:
The value of tag N. N can be an integer from 1 to 20.

The tag value can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 64 characters in length. It cannot contain \`http\://\` or \`https\://\`.

title.zh: 查询一个或多个迁移源信息

descriptions.zh:
## 接口说明

请求参数的作用类似于一个过滤器，过滤器为逻辑与（AND）关系。如果某一参数为空，则过滤器不起作用。
descriptions.en:
## Description

The request parameters are used as filters and are combined with a logical AND. If a parameter is empty, the corresponding filter is ignored.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun smc describe-source-servers --job-id j-bp19vlwm0tyigbmj0000 --state Available --name testSourceServerName --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --source-id s-bp1e2fsl57knvuug0000 --resource-group-id rg-acfmw3ty5y70000 --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --related-job-type Server --workgroup-id w-bp1ja22kdqphehlj0000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun smc DescribeSourceServers --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key TestKey --PageSize 10 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmw3ty5y70000' --SourceId.1 's-bp1e2fsl57knvuug0000' --RelatedJobType.1 Server --PageNumber 1 --State Available --Tag.1.Value TestValue --WorkgroupId 'w-bp1ja22kdqphehlj0000' --JobId 'j-bp19vlwm0tyigbmj0000' --Name testSourceServerName
